carrier_name: Mutual of Omaha (United of Omaha Life Insurance Company)

must_contain: United of Omaha Life Insurance Company

extraction_notes: This is a multi-product Mutual of Omaha "Group Insurance Proposal" document, each product on its own set of pages with a header banner naming the product (e.g., "VOLUNTARY DENTAL INSURANCE"). Products seen in this doc: Basic Term Life/AD&D, Voluntary Term Life/AD&D, Preferred Choice Voluntary STD, LTD, Voluntary Dental, Voluntary Critical Illness, Voluntary Hospital Indemnity, Voluntary Accident, Voluntary Vision (9 products total). For Voluntary Dental specifically: it defines two classes/plans - "Class 1: All Eligible Employees enrolled in High Plan" and "Class 2: ...enrolled in Low Plan" - these are the two plans to extract, each with its own complete Benefit Summary section (labeled "BENEFIT SUMMARY - CLASS 1" and "BENEFIT SUMMARY - CLASS 2") containing Policy Year Deductible (Type A waived; Type B,C individual $50/family 3x individual), Policy Year Maximum, Orthodontic Lifetime Maximum, Orthodontic Coverage (dependent children only), and Coverage Levels (Type A/B/C/Orthodontics percentages). Rate table appears later under "PARTICIPATION AND COST SUMMARY" with separate "COST SUMMARY - HIGH - CLASS 1" and "COST SUMMARY - LOW - CLASS 2" tables, each giving Assumed Lives, Monthly Rates, Monthly Premium, Annual Premium Sub-Total across 4 tiers (Employee Only, Employee+Spouse, Employee+Child(ren), Employee+Family) - use the "Monthly Rates" column as the per-tier premium. A "Total (All Classes)" row sums both classes - do not treat as a third plan. Covered Services detail (Type A/B/C/Orthodontics service lists) appear on subsequent pages, separately labeled "COVERED SERVICES - CLASS 1" and "COVERED SERVICES - CLASS 2" - these mirror each other except Class 1 major services replacement is "once in 10 years" vs Class 2 "once in 5 years". No separate in-network/out-of-network cost distinction is given for dental (deductible/max are cumulative across both). Rate guarantee for dental is 1 year (differs from other products' 2-year guarantee) with rate guarantee date 09/01/2027. Watch for other products in future docs from this carrier - each has similar structured sections: ELIGIBILITY, BENEFIT SUMMARY, PARTICIPATION AND COST SUMMARY, ADDITIONAL BENEFITS/FEATURES - useful pattern for extracting other product types too.
